These derivatives will prove  invaluable in the study of integration later in this text. The derivatives of inverse trigonometric functions are quite  surprising in that their derivatives are actually algebraic functions. Previously, derivatives of algebraic functions have  proven to be algebraic functions and derivatives of trigonometric functions have been shown to be trigonometric  functions. Here, for the first time, we see that the derivative of a function need not be of the same type as the original  function.
